description: Searches Poly Haven (polyhaven.com) for free CC0 3D assets and returns the direct CDN file URLs a three.js page needs: an HDRI (.hdr, for real environment light and reflections), a PBR texture set (diffuse, normal, roughness, AO/roughness/metal JPGs) or a model (.gltf plus its included files). Use it in 3D designs when procedural shapes and RoomEnvironment aren't enough: a stone floor, a wood table, a sky, a lantern, a chair. Each result has its id, name, categories, size in meters for models, a thumbnail, the file URLs at 1k (default) or 2k, the license (CC0: no attribution needed) and a 'Powered by Poly Haven' credit. Load the files straight from their URLs (the CDN allows it) or download them into the design's assets/ for offline use; for a model, map its includes with a LoadingManager URL modifier. Writes nothing. If Poly Haven can't be reached, it says so: fall back to procedural materials.

query.description: What to find, in a few words: a material ("cobblestone", "oak floor"), an object ("lantern", "armchair") or a sky ("sunset field", "overcast").

resolution.description: File resolution (default 1k; 2k only for the hero object).

type.description: hdri for environment light and sky, texture for a PBR surface, model for an object.

name: find_open_design_3d_assets
